K215 Rocq: decode-then-xstep enumerator and one general L1, as in Lean

Ports the Lean restructuring of EnumPerm (021d848979) to rocqperm/:
- EnumPerm.v: the command type, xstep and tupof move here from L1_CompPerm,
  and enum_step is `decode` (the command packed at a pointer) followed by
  xstep, instead of an inline four-way decoding.
- L1_SoundPerm.v: soundness is two command-level lemmas, xstep_inv and
  xstep_none (only NIP halts, on the cached code 1); Inv_step and halt_step
  are short consequences, without per-command case splits. The zero-start
  Inv_s0 and enum_sound, which nothing used, are gone.
- L1_CompPerm.v: step_read reduces to decode_fields (decode inverts the
  encoding) and step_pl to decode_le; reach and halts_from_reached work from
  any start state between candidates, and complete_from compiles the
  derivation behind START_Y with Y the state's own counter. The zero-start
  reach/halts_from_reach/enum_complete are gone.
- SeedPerm.v: one theorem, halts_from_iff (between candidates, with theorems
  in the registers, halting iff thm222 1); seedPerm_iff_thm is one line.
  The copy of the reachability induction (reach_from) is gone. 58 -> 19 lines.
- L2RootPerm_dispatch.v: root_sem unfolds decode and reduces xstep per
  command; MP splits on the modus-ponens test before injection.

names used downstream are unchanged (enum_step, run, halts_from,

K215/K217: DomRho8 as a 52-step condensed-detachment derivation, Lean and Rocq

rho8 a b c u = ((c -> u) -> a) -> ((a -> c) -> (b -> c)) is Lukasiewicz's single axiom of the
implicational calculus; DomImp grants it only for u <= a. DomRho8.rho8_all now derives every
instance by one condensed-detachment derivation of 52 modus-ponens steps (one lemma each) from
truth, modus ponens and the dominated rows, instead of replaying Source 149's certificate
(118 lemmas). Every side condition u <= a holds because u is a literal subterm of a (le_l/le_r),
is the code 0, or is a hypothesis of the lemma; no step needs the 0 -> 0 = 0 conversion.

  Lean DomRho8.lean   454 lines / 26,770 bytes -> 254 lines / 11,974 bytes (1.6 s)
  Rocq DomRho8.v      22,673 bytes (reflective certificate) -> 11,190 bytes (1.9 s),
                      the same derivation as direct lemmas

The public interface used by KCodeDom and ThmDom is unchanged (DomImp, rho8_all; le_l, le_r,
sub and wim00 are kept). The unused public helpers composition and lift_right are gone. Checked:
lake build of DomRho8 and KCodeDom (rho8_all: propext, Quot.sound); in Rocq, DomRho8 and
ThmDom compiled in the build tree (both closed under the global context); build.py
--check-only passes. The full 44-module Rocq compile with recursive coqchk follows separately.

New k225-formal/rho8cd/:
  derivation.txt           the derivation (formula, premises, side conditions per line)
  generate_domrho8_cd.py   renders it for Lean (--lean) and Rocq (--rocq), recomputing every
                           unifier so premises are applied at explicit instances; called by
                           regenerate215.py for coq/215/DomRho8.v
  search/                  the untrusted search: a given-clause prover in Rust (cdr) with
                           side-condition tracking and Veroff hints, and shrink.py (hint
                           deletion). Hints from the 111 statements of the old proof gave
                           86 steps in 6 s; hint-deletion passes gave 85 -> 61 -> 56 -> 54
                           nodes (52 lemmas plus the two leaves), a local optimum under four
                           parameter settings.

generate_domrho8_lean.py is marked superseded (kept as history).
